notional_positions.notes: Crude oil and feedstock purchase obligation derivatives designated as fair value hedges (inventory supply arrangement). Long purchase commitments.
Intermediates and refined products purchase obligation derivatives designated as fair value hedges (Inventory Intermediation Agreement).
Crude oil economic hedges (not designated). Used to manage price volatility in inventories and purchase/sale transactions. Direction not specified; assumed net short for inventory hedging.
Refined products economic hedges (not designated). Direction not specified; assumed net short for inventory hedging.

warnings: PBF does not disclose gross long/short positions for economic hedges. Economic hedge direction assumed net short for inventory hedging. Fair values in thousands: FVH crude $4,251K + intermediation $94,834K + economic $31,155K = approx $130M total asset.
